notes: All 17 lintFindings fixed (report[0]/[1]/[3]/[9]/[11] got pronoun-only corrections mandated by lint; report[7] was the one substantive report rewrite). Packet suspectName confirmed: 'Pop Blooming Burst' was a fusion of Pop Blossom and Blooming Burst — spikes[1] rewritten around Tangle-Barbs, the actual root. Chart: full sides moved from blanket 'Skill' to Taliyah on all 7 rows to match content win[] and the packet (win[] edits omitted — already correct); rows 4-6 ratings already 6/10, no-ops omitted. Whether Taliyah's W knockup interrupts Pop Blossom's preparation is not in the kit text — not asserted anywhere. A 50% win rate with an all-Taliyah level chart reads slightly generous, but both data layers agree so the chart was not second-guessed.
